title: Java Beer Summit
tagline: The biggest summer Java event in Sofia

location.name: Toplocentrala
location.description: A cultural hub in a former heat plant near South Park — indoor galleries, outdoor terraces, and the Bar Stage for exactly this kind of summer evening.
location.directions: Near South Park and the Hilton. Trams 1, 6, 7 (Blvd. P. Slaveykov); buses 72, 76, 102, 204, 304, 604 (Blvd. Cherni Vrah); metro M2 (European Union).

about.intro: Java Beer Summit is an annual event co-organized by the [Bulgarian Java User Group](https://jug.bg) and [Codexio](https://codexio.bg). It brings the Java community together in an informal setting, aiming to strengthen bonds within the community and welcome new people into it. The audience mainly consists of Java community supporters and newcomers drawn into their orbit. The 2026 edition is on 26 August at [Toplocentrala](https://toplocentrala.bg) near South Park. There is a stage where short talks are held with the goal of lifting the mood of attendees.

cfp.note: Got a talk in you? Pitch a subject and a few sentences about it — short, beer-friendly talks welcome. We'll get back to you about a slot.

registration.note: Free entry — register so we know roughly how much beer to pour.

schedule.title: AI in everyday life

schedule.title: Open Mic
schedule.abstract: The stage is yours — grab a beer and come up.
